note: S3 website endpoints do not support HTTPS, so the standard S3 (REST) origin is needed. The viewer-policy wording in A is slightly beside the point but it is the only workable option.
Dedicated IP custom SSL (legacy clients support); ACM certificates are not the typical pairing, but the stem accepts the extra cost.
NLB TCP listener passes TLS through; ALB has no TCP listener.
Imported certificates are not renewed by ACM; replace with an ACM public cert in us-east-1 (required for CloudFront).
Asymmetric KMS keys do not support automatic or on-demand rotation; the alias swap is the standard approach.
Missing validation record and certificate not in use by any integrated resource both block managed renewal. Note B is not a blocker (more associations are fine).

AWS guidance is that ACM leaf certificates change on renewal, so pin (if at all) to Amazon root CAs. Option C (reuse same public key) I am not certain exists for ACM public certificates; if it did, it could compete with D.
